environment.description: Spring Boot application deployed on EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2), running as root user behind an Application Load Balancer with no origin access restrictions. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 8080 directly to the application. The /tmp/docproc directory is world-writable (0777). Security groups allow inbound traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443 to ALB and ALB to EC2 on 8080. No additional request signing or authentication middleware is configured.
